notes: Authority Broker · Trust Domain B · Phase 8 v0.1.6. Mediates every capability request from NEX1. Ed25519-signed event log. Snapshot-owned. Capability-manifest-bound.

capability_token_binding.capability_manifest_hash: sha256 · bound · Manifest is immutable for Work Order duration
capability_token_binding.nex1_execution_instance_id: rotated per NEX1 process spawn · rotated on Broker restart

denial_evidence_classes: SANDBOX_DENIAL · attack stopped at OS/sandbox mechanism · never reached Broker (T3 NOT_IMPLEMENTED at v0.1.0)
BROKER_CAPABILITY_DENIAL · request reached Broker · Broker refused on capability policy

event_log_shape.kind: one of: CAPABILITY_REQUEST · CAPABILITY_GRANTED · CAPABILITY_DENIED · PROCESS_SPAWNED · FS_MUTATION · SNAPSHOT_CAPTURED · HANDOVER_REQUESTED · WORKSPACE_FROZEN · SCOPE_ESCAPE_ATTEMPT · MASTER_AUTHORITY_ELEVATION_ATTEMPT · PROTECTED_DATA_ACCESS_ATTEMPT · IPC_REPLAY_ATTEMPT · TOKEN_MANIFEST_MISMATCH · TOKEN_INSTANCE_MISMATCH · INTERPRETATION_AUTHORITY_EXCEEDED · NEX1_MISREPORT_DETECTED
event_log_shape.signature: Ed25519 signature over (prev_chain_hash + entry_sequence + kind + detail + at) using Broker private key · key_id + key_version recorded

invariants: Broker holds Ed25519 private key · never exposed
Public key distributed to Observer + Compliance Verifier + Evidence Validation for verification
Broker event log is append-only · never truncated · never rewritten
Every capability request is either granted (with signed event) or denied (with signed event)
NEX1 cannot access Broker internals · v0.1.0 T2 = in-process module boundary + interface-only exports · T3 = separate OS process
